lead: A segmented control: a row of mutually exclusive options with a sliding background under the selected one. It is a radiogroup: the arrow keys move and select, Home / End jump to either end, and only the selected item is in the tab order.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.root: The root, `role=radiogroup`; `data-size` / `data-full-width` / `data-disabled`, `data-empty` when nothing is selected, `data-ready` once the thumb is in place
styling.thumb: The sliding background under the selected item; its position comes from `--seg-x` / `--seg-w` on the root (pixels, no unit)
styling.parts: The icon and the text of an option
